text.p: NewReach Communications Inc said Wednesday it had made additional changes in its management team.
It said Martin Swarzman was replaced, by Richard R. Dwyer Jr., as chairman of the board and is no longer serving as a director.
Dwyer will remain as a company executive and Wayne Santini, will remain as president/chief creative officer and a director, NewReach said.
It said Richard K. Hagen was employed last month as chief executive officer and a director.
Gary W. Irving, 53, was employed in December as chief technical officer and a director.

Steven H. Grundstedt was employed on January 1 as chief financial officer and a director. Educated in engineering and business administration, Grundstedt has spent the last five years in the retail stockbrokerage industry with Merrill Lynch and most recently with Dain Bosworth.
